source_definition: Full-support observed-count GP mean with each dataset reviewed source kernel at76MeV, no mass-dependent generating truth and no retuning
analysis_policy: Unchanged reviewed mass-dependent states, same supports, 0.5MeV scan grid; source used only for null calibration
combined_definition: One common coupling among all active datasets at each mass, original frozen signal conversion; independent dataset count fluctuations with coherent full-spectrum draws
primary_local_ordering: z=(r-a)/s for raw positive signal fit; otherwise inclusive excess tail1
primary_global_ordering: Max z over sites with r_star=a+s*z>0 across declared full scope grid
response_method: Differential signed-profile-likelihood root propagation including GP count-dependent mean and covariance, checked against direct full-bin one-standard-deviation perturbations
validation: Complete independent Poisson spectra per dataset reused at every mass; same drawindex used in combination; retain explicit MonteCarlo intervals and approximation diagnostics
